interventions.dose: 200 nL x injection points, 5e+12 v.g./mL, L4-5 spinal dorsal horn microinjection

combinations.readout: mechanical pain threshold after intrathecal α-CGRP
combinations.magnitude: No nociception after intrathecal α-CGRP in RAMP1 knockdown adult mice, versus lowered threshold in sham and scramble groups (p = 0.0013, p = 0.0396)
combinations.model: physiological state (no injury), 4 weeks after AAV injection
combinations.evidence_quote: Meanwhile, the CGRP response after intrathecal injection indicated that adult mice with RAMP1 knockdown exhibited similar responses to aged mice, with decreased sensitivity to CGRP and no change in mechanical pain threshold (Fig. 5F).

interventions.dose: injected into L4-6 SDH 3 weeks after CCI

combinations.readout: mechanical pain threshold response to intrathecal α-CGRP
combinations.magnitude: No difference in CGRP response between aged sham mice and aged CCI mice with RAMP1 knockdown; higher than CCI and control virus groups (p = 0.0032, p = 0.0112)
combinations.model: chronic constriction injury, 5 weeks after AAV injection
combinations.evidence_quote: Moreover, no difference in response sensitivity to CGRP was observed between aged mice undergoing the sham operation and those with RAMP1 knockdown in the CCI group (Fig. 6C).
